message: No detected input validation: File paths are taken directly from user input and passed to pd.read_csv without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local CSV files and a local GloVe file via user-supplied paths with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authenticated source confirmation.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only prints unique label values for debugging purposes but performs no validation, distribution comparison, or anomaly detection to detect label-flipping attacks.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples at any point in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The Integrator class loads model JSON and weights from local files without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; no integrity verification is performed before use.

No detected label distribution validation: While compute_class_weight is used to handle imbalance during training, there is no explicit validation or check of label distribution or expected label set before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although multiple metrics are computed (accuracy, F1, precision, recall, confusion matrix), the test set is derived from the same train_test_split call used during training, is not cryptographically signed or hashed, and is not held out independently from the training pipeline, offering no real prot
No detected input sanitization: Tweets fetched from Twitter are passed directly to tokenization and the model without any shape, range, or content validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: The model predictions are collected into a list and returned as-is with no NaN guards, probability range checks, or threshold sanity validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a binary fake-news classifier (not an LLM), and no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation is implemented.
